claims.citation: New York Herald, 18 May 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Bark Advance (Br), Crosby, Antwerp, 44 days, with mdse
and 237 passengers, to Boyd & Hincken. Had a succession
of W and WSW gales; lost mizzenmast and maintopsailyard,
also lost and split sails. Had two births and two deaths
among the passengers.

claims.citation: The Sun (New York), 18 May 1866, p. 4, col. 3

claims.verbatim:
Bark Advance (of Yarmouth, N. S.), Crosby, Antwerp, 44 days,
with mdse. and 237 pass. to Boyd & Hincken. Had a succession of
W and WSW gales; lost mizzenmast and main-topsail yard; also, lost
and split sails. Had tow births and two deaths among the pass.
